description: This file defines a custom SwiftUI ViewModifier named StatusGlassCardModifier that applies a glass-like styled background with padding, rounded corners, stroke border, and shadow. It also extends the View protocol with a convenience method to apply this modifier easily.

classes.name: StatusGlassCardModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that adds padding, a rounded rectangle background with ultra-thin material fill, border stroke with adjustable opacity based on contrast, and a shadow, creating a glass-like card appearance.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view layout of the modifier, applying padding, background with overlay, stroke border with contrast-based opacity, and shadow.

methods.name: statusGlassCard
methods.description: An extension method on View that applies the StatusGlassCardModifier with specified brighten and padding parameters.
